title: PowerPoint for Windows: modernised Presenter View with one control bar and a slide strip
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap details, product-level licensing and narrowly stated documentation gaps are supported. The summary should say that no data change is described, rather than asserting none occurs, and the Mac comparison and audience-view explanation need their supporting sources cited.
